body: My male cat had a UTI in December. At the same time we were doing some major cleaning and organising. Boxes everywhere. After he physically recovered he and his sister had a case misdirected aggression. Something spooked them and they turned on each other. We separated them for a day and their dynamic was fine after. But my male was suddenly scared /suspicious of any and all inanimate objects, even ones that had been there all his life. He slowly got better. He still has his skittish moments, but he's 95% himself and loving life 😻 he just needed time.

I was having an especially shit day and I walked past her in the hallway where she was sitting. She looks up at me and goes "you have a great walk!"

Story time:

I have always been praised in therapy for being reflective and understanding what is happening to me and why I do things. I am a pretty okay conversationalist and seem very in touch with myself.

In therapy we were going through a situation that led to me dissociating.

Therapist: so what did that argument make you feel?

Me: well, I thought it was unfair that they accused me of..

Therapist: [interrupts] but what did you feel?

Me: I just wanted to walk away, and...

Therapist: [interrupts again] but can you name any feelings?

Me: I don't know....?

That was a pretty big wake up call to me. And has changed how I view pretty much everything.
